Submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Op 1 (minimality cure):** reduced to a pure numeral substitution — "[ * ] anniversary" → "twelve (12) month anniversary" — which brought the changed-character ratio to ~0.20 and passed the official gate.
- **Op 2 (separate tight insertion):** one short sentence carrying only the two required carve-outs (internal development; M&A-acquired Competing Products), stripped of the flagged extras ("Notwithstanding anything to the contrary,", "or manufacturing activities", "with respect to any compound or product", "nothing in this Section 8.2 shall restrict Ono or its Affiliates from").
- Level held at **fallback**, all five fallback elements mapped once (named product and in-term scope already met verbatim), status locked as **deviation**.
